name: ME Bake

description.short: Bake geometry into Rhino with Meanders attributes.
description.long: Bakes geometry or ME Objects into the active Rhino document. A Meanders Attribute can be supplied and defaults to an empty ME Attribute. The Bake input is true by default, and a Bake button is also available directly on the component. When Group branch items is enabled, which is the default, baked objects from each Grasshopper branch are placed into a Rhino group.

inputs.name: Geometry
inputs.description: Geometry or ME Objects to bake.

inputs.name: Attribute
inputs.description: Meanders attributes to apply while baking. Defaults to an empty ME Attribute.

inputs.name: Bake
inputs.description: When true, bake the supplied geometry during solution. Defaults to true.

examples.title: Bake branch geometry
examples.description: With Group branch items enabled, each Grasshopper branch is baked into its own Rhino group.

notes: The Bake input defaults to true.
An empty ME Attribute is used when no attribute is supplied.
The Bake button on the component bakes the current input data independently of the Bake input value.
Group branch items is enabled by default and can be changed from the component context menu.
The component outputs a text message rather than baked geometry.
